units.name: retrieve
units.description: Atomic intent: obtain an existing value or object from an addressed source.

units.name: counted_loop
units.description: Compound repetition behavior with initialization, continuation condition, body, and iteration step.

units.name: raster_image
units.description: Persistent image identity whose concrete payload may be represented by different raster formats without changing the represented asset identity.

forms.conditions: Retrieves projected data from a query source; not interchangeable with every operation named get.
Represents retrieval only when the host language/API uses get for reading rather than mutation or allocation.
Equivalent to the counted-loop glyph when initialization occurs once, condition is tested before each iteration, and step occurs after each completed body iteration.
Behaviorally equivalent to the matching for-loop only when continue/break/exception and step placement preserve the same control-flow semantics.
A PNG payload may represent the same SHAEP image identity as another supported encoding; byte identity is not implied.
A JPEG payload may represent the same SHAEP image identity as another supported encoding; visual fidelity and alpha capability may differ.

relations.conditions: Both forms must mean retrieval in the active context.
Initialization, test order, step order, continue behavior, break behavior, and side effects must match.
Both payloads resolve to the same SHAEP identity; equality of bytes or lossless visual data is not required.
